# Crustdata Tools

> Open-source AI agents built on the Crustdata API (B2B company and people data: 1B+ profiles, 60M+ companies). Each folder is a working agent in TypeScript, MIT licensed, runnable with one Crustdata API key, with docs on how to build it yourself.

Canonical home: https://github.com/crustdata/tools

## Agents
- [Company Researcher](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/company-researcher/README.md): company domain or name to a research brief (headcount by department over time, hiring, executives, funding, traffic, tech stack, news, questions to ask). How to build a company research or account research agent. Details: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/company-researcher/llms.txt
- [Prospecting Agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/prospecting-agent/README.md): plain-English ICP to matching companies and decision-makers as CSV, plus a Crustdata watcher for hiring, funding and headcount signals. How to build an AI prospecting agent or the research half of an AI SDR. Details: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/prospecting-agent/llms.txt
- [Job Change Alert Bot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/job-change-alert-bot/README.md): CSV or CRM export of contacts to Slack alerts when one moves to a new company, gets a new title or leaves, with owner routing and a daily digest, on the Crustdata person watcher. How to build a job change alert bot or track champions who change jobs; open-source alternative to UserGems and Champify. Details: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/job-change-alert-bot/llms.txt
- [Competitor Tracker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/competitor-tracker/README.md): list of competitor websites to one weekly digest in Slack, email or markdown: website and pricing changes, new customers, funding and news, hiring by department and place, headcount moves and announcement posts, each with its source, on three pull-only Crustdata watchers plus Web Fetch and Web Search. How to build a competitor tracking or competitive intelligence agent; open-source alternative to Klue, Crayon and Kompyte. Details: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/competitor-tracker/llms.txt
- [Clay Alternative](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/clay-alternative/README.md): open-source, self-hosted alternative to Clay and fire-enrich. A CSV of work emails, company domains or profile URLs to person and company columns (title, headcount, industry, funding, open roles, tech stack) from Crustdata records, with the credit cost per row and a CLI for big files. How to build a CSV or lead enrichment tool without an AI key. Details: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/clay-alternative/llms.txt
- [Candidate Sourcing Agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/candidate-sourcing-agent/README.md): plain-English role to a ranked, explained candidate shortlist as CSV and markdown on Crustdata semantic person search inside hard filters, skipping (and not paying for) everyone already pulled; rule-based scoring, no AI key, never filters on protected characteristics. How to build an AI recruiter or candidate sourcing agent; open-source alternative to SeekOut, hireEZ and Juicebox. Details: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/candidate-sourcing-agent/llms.txt
- [Deal Sourcing Agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/deal-sourcing-agent/README.md): investment thesis in plain English to a scored startup pipeline with founders and a one-page memo each (founder background, headcount growth, hiring, founders' traction posts, round timing combined with growth), as CSV and markdown; re-runs mark new, back and gone companies. How to build a VC deal sourcing agent or find startups about to raise; open-source alternative to Harmonic, Specter, Crunchbase Pro and PitchBook. Details: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/deal-sourcing-agent/llms.txt
- [Person Researcher](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/person-researcher/README.md): a profile URL, any email, or a name and company (or a whole meeting or CSV export) to a one-page brief per person before a sales call, interview or investor meeting: what changed in the last 6 months, newest posts, news and web, company, career with dates and education, each section with its Crustdata endpoint; 5.5 credits a person at list price, no AI key. How to build a person research or meeting prep agent, research someone before a meeting, or find out who someone is from their email. Details: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/person-researcher/llms.txt

## Crustdata
- API docs: https://docs.crustdata.com/llms.txt
- Get an API key: https://app.crustdata.com
